title: AMC 10 Practice: Winning Strategy in a Number Game — Who Wins?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on a two-player number game (subtract 1 or halve), solved with a table of winning positions and a counting trick. (Level 4 of 5)
Two players, one number, and a race to write zero. For how many starting numbers can the second player always win?

We build a table, spot the pattern, prove it, and then count two ways, including a slick doubling trick. Try the bigger challenge at the end!
